method.curve: BmAK `REV_RPM` x is normalised 0..1; JC3 drives rpm 1000..10000 (`LandAudio.min_rpm`/`max_rpm`), so rpm = min + x*(max-min). The y target (volume/pitch/low-pass) is not in the recovered data - UNKNOWN
method.gain: gain_db = slot LUFS - the LUFS of the span that feeds it (mono downmix, as the swap writes it); delivered_lufs is measured on the payload the swap would write (gain, trim/pad with zeros to the slot's frame count, PCM16 clip + quantise); delta_lu = delivered - slot is the +/-1 LU gate, clip_pct the share of samples the gain pushed into the clip
method.loop: no measured slot carries an FSB5 loop field (`loop_start` is null on every one); whether the loop is then produced by the event/tune graph, or this bank version simply carries no loop metadata, was not measured - UNKNOWN
method.slot: the bank stores event -> tune (`TLNS` -> `LIST TMLN` -> `TLNB`: body 0:16 is the tune GUID, 16:32 the GUID of the event that owns it) but stores no tune -> sample field, so the slot is chosen by sample name and audition; `slot_confidence` says whether test-060 already proved that index (`proven`) or it is a name match (`candidate`)
method.stretch: the swap must keep the slot's byte size (route a), so the source is trimmed/padded to `frames`; stretch_ratio = frames / payload source frames
